apps.name: WhatsApp
apps.label: WhatsApp
apps.description: Your chats in a little panel. Scan the QR code once with your phone and it stays logged in.

apps.name: Spotify
apps.label: Spotify
apps.description: Spotify's player in a panel. The button shows what's playing; middle-click to play or pause.

apps.name: Reolink Camera
apps.label: Doorbell
apps.description: A quick peek at a Reolink camera or doorbell on your home network. Log in once and it stays logged in. Right-click its button for the full camera controls.

menu.label: Show / hide camera controls
menu.js: (d => { if (d.dataset.peekOff) { delete d.dataset.peekOff; d.classList.add('peek'); } else { d.dataset.peekOff = '1'; d.classList.remove('peek'); } })(document.documentElement)

apps.name: Calendar
apps.label: Calendar
apps.description: Upcoming events from your shared calendars (iCloud, Google or Outlook), read-only. Add as many calendar links as you like from the menu, star the one that should open first, or see them all together.

title.labelOption: Show today's next event on the button

apps.page:
Today

Calendars
Add a calendar

The starred calendar is the one that opens first.

apps.name: Hue Lights
apps.label: Hue
apps.description: Control your Philips Hue lights from the taskbar. Opens on your favourite room or zone, and every room, zone, scene and light is one click away. Connects straight to your Hue Bridge at home; no account needed.

title.labelOption: Show your favourite room's lights on the button

apps.page:

Hue
